_comment: Single source of truth for the research-topic taxonomy. RESEARCH-TOPICS.md and reviews/by-topic.html are both GENERATED from this by build_topics.py. To add/rename a topic, edit here. 'aliases' lists the exact appendix-theme names a conference report may use for this topic; the build maps report themes -> canonical topic by matching name or alias (case/space/ampersand-insensitive) and FAILS on any unmapped theme.

topics.name: Reasoning-first ranking & LLM rerankers
topics.desc: When the ranker reasons before it orders — listwise LLM rerankers, cross-encoders trained to think, reasoning-intensive retrieval. My interest: when a reasoning reranker actually beats a cheap cross-encoder, and what it costs per query.

topics.name: Dense / sparse / multi-vector retrieval & learnt representations
topics.desc: Learned representations for first-stage retrieval — dense bi-encoders, learned sparse, ColBERT-style late interaction, embedding models, ANN. My interest: representation quality vs. index/latency budget, and how small an encoder can get before recall breaks. (Learnt representations stay core even in otherwise-peripheral areas.)

topics.name: Agentic retrieval, deep research & RAG
topics.desc: Retrieval as a multi-turn loop an agent drives — deep-research agents, iterative/agentic search, RAG training and robustness. My interest: closing the loop between retrieval and reasoning, and the cost/faithfulness trade-off of doing it agentically.
aliases: Retrieval for agents, deep research, RAG & QA

topics.name: Query & intent understanding, search behavior
topics.desc: What the user actually wants — query rewriting/expansion, intent, session/conversational search, and how generative answers change search behavior. My interest: where a generated answer should replace a ranked list, and where it shouldn't.
aliases: Search behavior, query & intent understanding, GenAI-vs-search

topics.name: Evaluation, relevance judgments & LLM-as-judge
topics.desc: How we know a system is better — test-collection design, LLM-generated relevance judgments, judge reliability and bias. My interest: trusting an LLM to grade another LLM, and when that quietly breaks.

topics.name: Fact-checking, verification & factuality
topics.desc: Retrieval in service of truth — claim verification, evidence retrieval, hallucination/factuality, and detecting model-generated or harmful content in the corpus. My interest: retrieval that defends the pipeline rather than just feeds it.

topics.name: Learning-to-rank theory, bias, click models & fairness
topics.desc: The statistics of ranking from implicit feedback — unbiased LTR, position/selection bias, click models, exposure fairness.

topics.name: Multimodal, cross-modal & structured retrieval
topics.desc: Retrieval beyond plain text — visual-document retrieval, cross-modal embeddings, retrieval over tables/graphs/code.

topics.name: Domain & specialized retrieval, resources
topics.desc: Retrieval in the hard verticals — legal, medical, scientific, code — plus the benchmarks and datasets that make progress measurable.

topics.name: Generative recommendation, semantic IDs & LLM recommenders
topics.desc: Recommenders that generate item identifiers instead of scoring a fixed catalogue — semantic IDs, generative retrieval for recsys, LLM-as-recommender.

topics.name: Recommendation: sequential, multimodal, graph, CF, CTR & ads
topics.desc: The rest of the recsys stack — sequential/session models, graph and collaborative filtering, CTR prediction and ads.

topics.name: Self-improving & self-evolving systems
topics.desc: Agents that get better from their own experience — self-evolving memory, experience distillation, on-policy self-adaptation. My interest: whether "it improved on the benchmark" is really improvement, and how to check faithfulness.

topics.name: Recursive self-improvement & self-play
topics.desc: One level up: systems that evolve the machinery of improvement — memory architecture, reward, verifier — plus self-play, a model proposing and solving its own challenges. My interest: where the recursion compounds vs. plateaus, and keeping generator and solver honest.

topics.name: Self-reward, self-verification & self-consistency
topics.desc: Where the reward comes from when nobody labels anything — self-rewarding models, intrinsic/verifiable rewards, self-consistency, weak-vs-strong verification.

topics.name: Self-correction, self-reflection & test-time RL
topics.desc: Correction as an objective, not a decoding trick — test-time RL from self-generated labels, multi-attempt reasoning, self-refinement grounded in solvers/verifiers.

topics.name: Self-training & self-distillation
topics.desc: Bootstrapping supervision from the model itself — self-taught reasoners (STaR-style), on-policy self-distillation, error-aware self-reflection for distillation.

topics.name: Reasoning & test-time compute
topics.desc: Chain-of-thought, inference-time scaling, adaptive/efficient reasoning. My interest: buying accuracy with compute without paying for it on easy inputs.

topics.name: Agents, tool use & multi-agent systems
topics.desc: LLMs that act — tool use, multi-agent coordination, agent benchmarks and robustness under noise.

topics.name: RL, RLHF & preference optimization
topics.desc: Aligning and sharpening models with feedback — RLHF, DPO and variants, GRPO, robust preference learning, reward modeling.

topics.name: Alignment, safety & interpretability
topics.desc: Making models safe and legible — jailbreak/defense, safety benchmarks, steering, interpretability.

topics.name: Efficiency: distillation, MoE, long-context & decoding
topics.desc: Doing more with less — mixture-of-experts, KV-cache compression, speculative/sparse decoding, long-context. Distillation is core because it transfers to ranking.

topics.name: Multilinguality & low-resource
topics.desc: Reasoning and retrieval across languages — cross-lingual transfer, low-resource languages, translation.

topics.name: Theory: optimization & generalization
topics.desc: The why-it-works layer — scaling laws, generalization bounds, optimization dynamics.

topics.name: Diffusion & flow-based generation
topics.desc: The generative-modelling core — diffusion, flow matching, sampling theory and distillation.

topics.name: Multimodal & speech
topics.desc: Vision-language and speech models, multimodal reasoning and grounding.

topics.name: Perspectives & position papers
topics.desc: Field-shaping arguments — where a subfield should go, what it's getting wrong. Usually one or two per report, flagged as opinion.
